verdict.rationale: Elasticsearch's first-party docs describe a public API surface: official client libraries for popular languages, a forward-compatibility policy for clients, an inference API, Query DSL and ES|QL references, and a REST API reference linked from the hybrid-search docs. The OpenAPI probe returned 404 only at generic website paths, which shows no machine-readable spec was found there but does not contradict the documented API. Missing for 10: an explicit excerpt from the REST API reference itself, a discoverable machine-readable OpenAPI spec, and independent hands-on corroboration of agent-driven API use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: Elasticsearch is easy to use from most popular programming languages, thanks to the wide range of official libraries and developer tools available.
The forward compatibility policy allows client applications to continue to work with the new server before the client itself is upgraded.
The inference API workflow is more complex but offers greater control over the inference endpoint configuration.
Browse the docs for Query DSL, ES|QL, KQL, and more.
Vector and hybrid search, reranking, and GPU inference in one API.
